verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's official integrations page says you can build search interfaces by pairing Meilisearch with React InstantSearch. That is a ready-made UI component library, but it is a third-party library connected via integration rather than Meilisearch's own components. The docs also say faceting powers category navigation in your UI, and one community user reports that getting a frontend multi-index search running was easy. Missing for 10: Meilisearch-built UI component libraries, documentation of specific components (search box, results, facets, pagination), coverage beyond React, and hands-on corroboration of a full interface built with them.
